articles.summary: Alliance Resource Partners, L.P. (NASDAQ: ARLP) will report its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Monday, October 26, 2026. Alliance management will discuss these results during a conference call beginning at 10:00 a.m. Eastern that same day. To participate in the conference call, dial U.S. Toll Free (877) 407-0784 and request to be connected to the Alliance Resource Partners, L.P. earnings conference call. International callers should dial (201) 689-8560 and request to be connected to the same call. Investors may also listen to the call via the "Investors" section of ARLP’s website at www.arlp.com . An audio replay of the conference call will be available for approximately one week. To access the audio replay, dial U.S. Toll Free (844) 512-2921; International Toll (412) 317-6671 and request to be connected to replay using access code 13762993. articles.summary: 2026 Quarter Highlights Total revenues of $603.0 million and net income attributable to ARLP of $139.6 million, up year-over-year 5.5% and 46.8%, respectively Adjusted EBITDA attributable to ARLP of $233.9 million, up 26.3% year-over-year Segment Adjusted EBITDA Expense per ton sold at our Coal Operations improved 13.1% year-over-year and 7.9% sequentially Record oil gas royalty revenues and volumes, driven by $223.5 million of acquisitions completed during the quarter Distributable Cash Flow of $136.8 million and Distribution Coverage Ratio of 1.76x improved over 27% sequentially Declares quarterly cash distribution of $0.60 per unit, or $2.40 per unit annualized Alliance Resource Partners, L.P. (NASDAQ: ARLP) (“we,” “us,” “our,” “ARLP” or the “Partnership”) today reported financial and operating results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 (the “2026 Quarter” and “2026 Period,” respectively).
